# Jenny's Nails

> Nail salon based in Bloomington, Indiana. Builder gel, hand-painted designs and wine-and-massage pedicures on North Walnut. Bring a photo or bring an idea, and leave with a set you can't stop looking at.

- Phone: (812) 650-1001
- Based in: Bloomington, IN
- Nearby areas: Bloomington, Ellettsville, Spencer, Nashville, Bedford
- Google rating: 4.2 from 256 reviews

## Services
- Gel manicures: Glossy gel color that lasts, or a classic manicure with regular polish. Polish changes any time.
- Builder gel: Strength and shape for your natural nails. Regulars with tiny nails and short nail beds swear by it.
- Acrylics & fills: Long coffin, almond or square sets, done neat and kept fresh with fills.
- Dip & ombre: SNS dip powder and soft ombre fades, pink to white or any color you like.
- Nail art: Snowflakes, bows, florals, hearts, chrome and gems. If you want designs, this is the place.
- Pedicures: Wine or water, your choice of scent, and a foot and leg massage that isn't rushed.

## About
Jenny's Nails sits at 1000 N Walnut St, Suite C, just north of downtown Bloomington. Owner Jenny Pham built it into the kind of place regulars stick with for years: clients say they've been coming for three, four, even seven years, and that everyone does a great job and makes you feel welcome. Designs are the specialty. Snowflakes and bows painted by hand, florals, hearts, chrome, matte, glitter and gems, or the set you found online and want recreated. Jenny herself is known for being meticulous, the person clients with tiny nails and short nail beds finally trust to get it right. In 2023 the salon expanded and was remodeled, so there's more room, a clean, spa-like feel and pedicure chairs that come with a glass of wine, your choice of scent and a proper foot and leg massage. Walk-ins are welcome, and IU students get 10% off with their student ID.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes, walk-ins are welcome Monday to Saturday. Weekday afternoons and Saturdays get busy, so book ahead online or call (812) 650-1001 if you want a set time.
- Q: Do you have a student discount?
  A: Yes. IU students get 10% off with a student ID. Regulars say mornings and early afternoons between classes are the quickest time to come in.
- Q: Do you do nail art and custom designs?
  A: Yes, it's what we're known for. Bring an inspiration photo or describe the look, from hand-painted snowflakes and bows to florals, chrome, glitter and gems. Basic designs start at $7 and we'll price bigger designs before we start.
- Q: What is builder gel?
  A: Builder gel is a thicker gel that adds strength and structure to your natural nails, so your manicure lasts and holds its shape. A builder gel full set is $60 and a fill is $50.
- Q: Which pedicure should I choose?
  A: The Spa Pedicure ($35) is the classic with a lotion massage and hot towel. Signature ($45) adds a sugar scrub and callus treatment, Deluxe ($55) adds a moisturizing mask, and Luxury ($65) adds paraffin wax. Add gel polish on your toes for $15.
- Q: Where are you and when are you open?
  A: 1000 N Walnut St, Suite C, Bloomington, IN 47404, with free parking. Monday to Thursday 10 am to 7 pm, Friday 10 am to 7:30 pm, Saturday 10 am to 6 pm, closed Sunday.
- Q: How do I book?
  A: Book online through our Vagaro page, call (812) 650-1001, or just walk in. If you need to cancel or reschedule, please let us know at least 3 hours ahead.
